parameters.query: SELECT p.id as project_id, p.title, p.state, p.overall_score, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.error_log, p.state_history, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.updated_at - p.created_at)) as total_duration_seconds, r.id as review_id, r.review_type, r.score as review_score, r.feedback, pc.id as prompt_id, pc.prompt_text, pc.response, pc.tokens_used, pc.latency_ms, pc.backend FROM projects p LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN prompt_calls pc ON pc.project_id = p.id WHERE p.id = $1

INSERT INTO learning_data (project_id, performance_metrics, prompt_analysis, backend_analysis, lessons, tuning_recommendations, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6::jsonb, NOW()) RETURNING id

UPDATE projects SET state = 'learned', updated_at = NOW(), state_history = state_history || jsonb_build_object('state', 'learned', 'at', NOW(), 'details', 'Learning analysis completed') WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, state

INSERT INTO project_events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'learning_completed', jsonb_build_object('lessons_extracted', $2, 'tuning_recommendations', $3), NOW()) RETURNING id

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { error: 'No project data found', project_id: $('Webhook Trigger').first().json.body?.project_id } }];
